frozen_settings.rule: Test split is read once, after this file is written. No setting below may change afterwards.
frozen_settings.decision_rule: probs = softmax(logits / T); pred = argmax; if max(probs) < threshold -> 'unknown' (calibration.apply_threshold)

audio_paths.clean: preprocess_file (dataset.py path, no band-pass, no enhance)
audio_paths.sim: load_audio -> Butterworth-4 band-pass [200.0, 3800.0] Hz (sosfiltfilt) -> enhance_waveform -> preprocess_waveform (dashboard laser channel)

deployed.calibrated_on: its own Kaggle validation fold (stored in checkpoint, not re-fitted)
deployed.note: deployed checkpoint - training provenance not established as speaker-disjoint from this test set (trained on a Kaggle fold of a superset of these sources), information only

seeds.note: evaluation is deterministic; seed only fixes torch/numpy/random state

frozen_settings.feature: mel (40 log-mel bands, standardised), 8 kHz, 1.0 s clips

acceptance_criteria.statement: fine-tuned test sim_all digit_acc >= reference test sim_all digit_acc + 0.05
acceptance_criteria.rationale: the fine-tune must buy a clear gain on simulated laser audio (Exp 6 saw +12 pts)

acceptance_criteria.statement: fine-tuned test clean digit_acc >= reference test clean digit_acc - 0.03
acceptance_criteria.rationale: clean-audio accuracy may not be sacrificed by more than 3 points

acceptance_criteria.statement: fine-tuned test sim_all balanced_acc >= reference test sim_all balanced_acc
acceptance_criteria.rationale: unknown rejection on sim must not collapse while digits improve
the tuned threshold must not reject real digits

additions.note: Pre-registered follow-ups (coordinator request): continued_clean = reference + fine-tune recipe with NO sim clips (control for 'more training'); finetuned_long = same fine-tune recipe, max 30 epochs. Both val-selected and calibrated on val before any test score was seen.
additions.criteria: scored under the same conditions and metrics; original models' test rows are not recomputed
